entries.01777e45203d94ca: This is a single-segment business centered on operating a restaurant information website, supporting restaurants in attracting customers and managing their businesses. entries.53d6f4cd9d5a03c0: Under its purpose 'Connecting through food. Fulfilling people.,' the company has formulated the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2028' covering the fiscal years from March 2027 to March 2029, and its vision is to be a 'true' supporter of restaurants. The company-wide policies are 'transformation of the value provided' and 'expansion of the restaurant network,' and it sets out five strategies: strengthening media and membership services, establishing the agent business, expanding membership value, strengthening the sales structure and improving operating processes, and building and utilizing a data foundation suited to the AI era.

entries.f82b05f6c8a949a3: The restaurant information website, launched in 1996, is a long-established service that supports restaurants in attracting customers.
